svg.text: Two ways a session enters. One gate. Three bearers. Red markers are the gaps that survived review — nine, listed at the foot.
A · INGRESS — THE FORK THAT EXPLAINS EVERYTHING
B · THE GATE — resolveAuthorize · LIVE PATH ONLY
Your invariant is already here — a serial with no contract, or an agreement with zero clauses, is refused at the gate.
Shadow mode: the verdict is computed,
Zaptec must send an identity. With auth
off, it sends the charger's default tag.
Both paths converge. The CDR is the record;
money is derived from it, never destructively.
vendor path: connector_id null · energy = z.Energy ?? 0
A third door. Resolves a driver with
D · WHO PAYS — THE LADDER, THEN THE BEARER
each attribute (bearer · rate · allocation) walks independently
Nothing matches → the AgreementClause default, which is the
installation-level generic scheme every driver inherits.
BearerType — three, and the model uses all three
E · MONEY OUT — ONE ENGINE, TWO LINES
The part that is genuinely good — every step refuses rather than guesses
no_lines (a zero total is not issued) · registered_id_missing · period_closed · cross_tenant_snapshot
Four of five onboarding steps have an API.
Setting the flat-fee agreement has none.
F · AND NOTHING WATCHES ANY OF IT
The liveness sweeper is written, tested 31 ways, and called by nothing.

Sentry is not installed. The metrics module has no importer. All eight Resend templates are onboarding. When the OCPP path goes quiet, a log line is written and no human is told — which is why a three-month configuration change and a genuine fault look identical in the data.

g.text: Import drops Charger.Active; connectors have no disabled_at. Bills 30 where 20 exist.
The CDR import path never reaches the gate. Needs its own contract check at import.
z.Energy ?? 0 — a missing energy field prices as a free charge and marks itself complete.
The default idTag is not registered. Register it as a normal token; the clause sets bearer org.
enforceAuthorize defaults false — the verdict is right and discarded. Unblocked by 4.
Membership has no validity window. No move-out; the unique forbids history.
No agreement write surface — step 5 of onboarding needs a hand-edited row.
The webhook receiver resolves a driver with no membership check.
Nothing alerts when the protocol path goes silent.
Not shown: reset and unlock are mapped and unreachable by any route.
